name: Tinker: Restorative Beacon respects cross-faction party membership (#9567)
contract: npc_ascension_tinker_device::IsSummonedBy (AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp) only gave m_ControlledByPlayer/UNIT_FLAG_PLAYER_CONTROLLED/byte2 to Turret and Explosive summons, never to Beacon() devices (9 entries including 50037 Restorative Beacon, confirmed as spell 801801's EffectMiscValue[1] summon target). Unit::BuildValuesUpdate only patches cross-faction faction visibility for raid viewers when IsControlledByPlayer() is true, so a beacon stayed hostile-looking to an opposite-faction groupmate and became attackable, exactly like Witch Doctor's Serpent Ward before #1719. The fix adds Beacon(me->GetEntry()) to that condition so beacons get the same treatment as turrets and explosives.

steps.label: An opposite-faction party member cannot attack the beacon
An unflagged owner does not expose the beacon to outsider attacks
